notes: CANONICAL for Annika Olsdotter (b. 23 May 1800, Myckleby/Önne / d. 1876, Tegneby/Lunnaslätt), daughter of Olof Germundsson (I182292319587) & Inger (Ingrid) Svensdotter (I182292319579), wife of Samuel Olsson. Her husband Samuel Olsson also exists twice: this record's spouse link (I182292318241) is the canonical copy (father of the canonical Sven Johan). The duplicate (I182195862070) additionally gives 'Rom, Tegneby, Göteborg och Bohuslän' as a birthplace, worth preserving if merged, but is parented to the duplicate Sven Johan branch.

Her son Sven Johan Samuelsson also exists twice, already flagged in direct-line-issues.md (gen 6): this record's child link (I182197443214) is the CANONICAL copy - see its own manual notes and docs/research/ancestors/gen06-sven-johan-samuelsson-gustava-samuelsdotter.md for the full write-up.
